description: A results file of the agent eval: a run of the `spec` or `tsx` mode, of the run-time lane (`runtime`), or of the project lane (`project`).

anyOf.description: One run of the agent eval: per-run measurements and their summary, per brief and overall.

schema.description: Identifies the shape. Bumped only by a breaking change.

at.description: When the run started, as an ISO timestamp in UTC.

model.description: The model id, or `fake` for the scripted model.

mode.description: What the agent hands back: a `polymorph-screen/1` document or a TSX module.

runner.description: `api`: the harness sent each request to the Messages API. `cli`: each run went through `claude -p`, and `codex`: through `codex exec`, with the same tools served over MCP. All three are measured the same way, apart from what Codex does not report.

anyOf.description: The version of the harness the runner ran, as its `--version` prints it: Claude Code for the `cli` runner, Codex for the `codex` runner; `scripted` for their stand-ins. Null for the API runner.

fake.description: True for the scripted model. A fake run measures the harness.

partial.description: True for a checkpoint, written after every run while the eval is under way, and for an eval that stopped before every run finished. A partial file is never the number.

anyOf.description: Why the eval stopped early; null when it did not.

reason.description: `api`: the Messages API refused, or kept failing. `cli`: the harness the runner started (Claude Code or Codex) failed, or reported an error, such as one from the API. `usage-limit`: the harness reported a usage or rate limit on the account it is signed in to. `tokens-per-run`, `tokens-total`: a token ceiling was reached. `tokens-unknown`: `--max-tokens-total` was given, and a run ended before its harness reported its tokens, so the ceiling could no longer be held.

brief.description: The brief whose run was under way.

tokens.description: Tokens the unfinished run had spent, discarded attempts included. It has no record.

version.description: The registry’s version: the release that was measured.

anyOf.description: The commit the eval ran on, when there is one.

briefs.description: Every brief in `eval/briefs/` when the eval ran, by name. Only a run over all of them can be the number; one over fewer is a smoke run.
The glob the briefs were chosen by.

maxIterations.description: The iteration cap: `validate` calls before a run is stopped.

effort.description: The effort sent as `output_config.effort`, passed to Claude Code as `--effort`, or to Codex as `model_reasoning_effort`; `default` sends none, so the model’s own default applies, or the harness’s own.

anyOf.description: The token ceiling per run, counted as `inputTokens`, `outputTokens` and `discardedTokens` together. No request starts once a run has reached it. Null for the `codex` runner: Codex reports its tokens only when its turn completes, so no ceiling per run can be held.

maxTokensTotal.description: The same ceiling over the whole eval.

outputs.description: The file beside this one that holds every run’s final document.

requirements.description: What each chosen brief required when the eval ran, in brief order. Absent in a results file written before requirements were judged.

brief.description: The brief these requirements belong to.

digest.description: A digest of the requirements as they were checked. Two results files whose digests differ for a brief judged it by different requirements, so their `meetsBrief` rates do not compare.

says.description: What the requirement asks for, in words.

runs.description: How many runs this summary covers, harness faults included.

measured.description: How many of them the rates and means are over: every run that did not end in a harness fault. The size of the sample each interval is computed from.

endings.description: How the runs ended. A `harness` run is left out of every figure below except the retry totals; a `refusal` or `max_tokens` run is counted, and never as lawful.

anyOf.description: The share of runs, from 0 to 1, whose first `validate` call came back lawful. Null when every run was a harness fault.
The 95% Wilson interval of `firstShotRate`, from 0 to 1: the rates the measured runs are consistent with.
The share of runs, from 0 to 1, whose final document is lawful. Null when every run was a harness fault.
The 95% Wilson interval of `lawfulRate`, from 0 to 1: the rates the measured runs are consistent with.
The share of runs, from 0 to 1, whose final document meets every requirement of its brief. Null when every run was a harness fault.
The 95% Wilson interval of `meetsBriefRate`, from 0 to 1: the rates the measured runs are consistent with.
The share of runs, from 0 to 1, whose final document is lawful and meets its brief: the screens that may be written and do what was asked. Null when every run was a harness fault.
The 95% Wilson interval of `lawfulAndMeetsBriefRate`, from 0 to 1: the rates the measured runs are consistent with.

failedRequirements.description: Every requirement a measured run did not meet, as `<brief>/<id>`, counted over the runs.

additionalProperties.description: How many runs did not meet it.

lawfulWithoutValidate.description: Runs that ended lawful although no `validate` call came back lawful: the model answered without validating what it handed back. Never part of `meanIterations`.

records.description: One record per finished run, by brief and then by run.

brief.description: The brief’s file name in `eval/briefs/`, without `.md`.

run.description: Which run of this brief, from 1.

firstShotLawful.description: Whether the first `validate` call reported no faults, no violations and nothing fatal. False when the run never called `validate`.

anyOf.description: `validate` calls up to and including the first lawful one. Null when no call came back lawful, whether or not the final document is lawful.

lawful.description: Whether the final document passes the same check `validate` runs. The harness checks it itself, so a run that answers without validating is still judged. Always false for a run that ended in `refusal`, `max_tokens` or `harness`.

meetsBrief.description: Whether the final document meets every requirement of its brief (`eval/requirements/<brief>.json`). The harness checks the document itself. Always false for a run that ended in `refusal`, `max_tokens` or `harness`. Absent in a results file written before requirements were judged.

failedRequirements.description: The requirements the final document does not meet, by id, in the brief’s order: every one when there is no document or it cannot be read. Empty for a run that ended `harness`, which is not judged.

ended.description: `answered`: the model stopped. `cap`: the iteration cap was reached with the last `validate` call unlawful. `turns`: the request limit was reached; Codex reports no request, so for the `codex` runner it is counted in tool calls. `max_tokens`: a response was cut off. `refusal`: the model declined. `harness`: the harness itself failed, so the run measures nothing about the model.

anyOf.description: What failed when the run ended `harness`; null for every other run.
Every input token the model read across the run: uncached, cache writes and cache reads. Null when the harness did not report it: Codex reports its tokens only when it finishes on its own.
The part of `inputTokens` read from the prompt cache.
The part of `inputTokens` written to the prompt cache. Null where the harness reports no such part.
Every output token across the run, thinking included.

Tokens of attempts that broke off mid-stream and were sent again, as far as their usage was reported. Billed, but in neither `inputTokens` nor `outputTokens`. Null for the `codex` runner, because Codex does not report them.

wallMs.description: Wall-clock time from the first request to the end of the run, tools included and retry waits (`backoffMs`) left out.

anyOf.description: Requests sent again after a transient failure. Null for the `codex` runner, because Codex does not report them.
Time spent waiting before those requests, in milliseconds. Null for the `codex` runner.
Messages API requests the run made, retries not counted, through the `api` or the `cli` runner. Null for the `codex` runner, because Codex reports no request.

toolCalls.description: How often the model called each tool.

violationsSeen.description: Everything the `validate` calls reported, counted. Red-rule violations by rule name; spec faults as `spec: <message>` with names and values elided, so the same mistake counts once per kind; `fatal` for a document that could not be read; `contract` for a module that imports nothing from the vocabulary.

additionalProperties.description: How many times it was reported.

misses.description: Each `validate` call that came back unlawful, in the words the model was shown, so a miss can be acted on where `violationsSeen` only counts it. Absent in a results file written before this field was kept.

anyOf.description: What made the document unreadable, or null.

faults.description: Every spec fault, in the validator’s words.

planUpdates.description: How often Codex started or updated its plan (its `todo_list` items). Its plan tool, which no setting turns off, writes nothing and calls nothing. Present for the `codex` runner only.

Milliseconds from sending the request that was answered to the first text of its answer. Thinking is not text, so time spent thinking is inside it. Null when the answer has no text, and for the `cli` and `codex` runners, which do not report when they send a request.

records.description: One record per finished run, by brief and then by run.

brief.description: The brief’s file name in `eval/briefs/`, without `.md`.

run.description: Which run of this brief, from 1.

lawful.description: Whether the project ends lawful: `polymorph check` reads every file and reports no violation, and every spec the harness wrote under `src/screens/` passes the spec check `validate` runs. False for a run that ended `harness`.

violations.description: What made the project unlawful, as `path: rule: message`, in the words of the check that reported it, at most twenty.

anyOf.description: Whether the app’s `typecheck` and `build` scripts both pass at the end. Null when the app was not installed, so neither ran.
The script that failed and the end of what it printed; null otherwise.

Whether the screen the harness wrote meets every requirement of its brief (`eval/requirements/<brief>.json`). False when it wrote none, or only modules that hold none. Null when it wrote one the requirements cannot read: a Vue or Svelte single-file component, an Angular component, or a page that uses the elements.

failedRequirements.description: The requirements the screen does not meet, by id, in the brief’s order: every one when the harness wrote no screen. Empty when the screen was not judged.

anyOf.description: What was judged against the brief; null when the harness wrote no screen.

kind.description: `spec`: specs the harness wrote under `src/screens/`, judged together. `tsx`: React or Solid modules it wrote under `src/`, judged together, which name the same members. `unread`: a Vue or Svelte single-file component, an Angular component or a page that uses the elements, which the requirements cannot read.

files.description: The files judged, relative to the project.

written.description: Every file the harness added or changed, relative to the project, outside `node_modules` and the build’s output.

ended.description: `answered`: the harness finished on its own. `turns`: the turn budget stopped it (responses for Claude Code; tool calls for Codex, which reports no response). `time`: the time budget stopped it. `harness`: the eval failed, so the run measures nothing about the model.

anyOf.description: What failed when the run ended `harness`; null for every other run.
Every input token the harness reported, cached and uncached. Null when it reported none: Codex reports its tokens only when it finishes on its own.
The part of `inputTokens` read from the prompt cache.
The part of `inputTokens` written to the prompt cache.
Every output token the harness reported, thinking included.

wallMs.description: Milliseconds from the harness’s start-up report to its end.

anyOf.description: Responses the harness reported. Null for Codex, which reports none.

mcpCalls.description: The MCP tools the harness called, by tool name.

verbs.description: The `polymorph` verbs the harness ran in shell commands, by verb: through `npx`, `pnpm`, the bin by its path, or `polymorph` on the `PATH`.

skills.description: The skills the harness loaded, by name: a Claude Code `Skill` call, or a `SKILL.md` the harness read.

anyOf.description: Tool calls the harness refused: a permission Claude Code denied, a command Codex declined, or an MCP call it denied. Null when Claude Code was stopped before it reported its result, which is where it reports what it refused.
Requests the harness reported sending again after a transient failure. Null for Codex, which does not report them.
